doctrine: The turn is the plan (owner directive 2026-08-09): a session ends only when every item is done or a valid stop reason is recorded (user-stop, irreversible, external-prereq). Deferral to fresh context is NOT a stop reason. cmd/plan owns dispatch bookkeeping; the continuation rule itself lives in skill.md and is followed, not hook-enforced (hook wiring is the owner's environment decision). Owner directive 2026-08-09: (a) per-rung validation is head-to-head -- run the adaptive_new and overgo implementations on the same artifact and inputs, adopt whichever component structures measure better, overgo ends at-or-below on wall+memory; (b) multimodal capabilities are tested when applicable -- image, video, and audio rungs exercise real modality inputs drawn from the repodb dataset catalog (adaptive_new docs/repodb datasets.log; resolved via the dataroot contract), never synthetic-only.

steps.title: per baseline policy; check what adaptive trains for needle first
steps.verdict: ABSENT-baseline: adaptive serves needle but does not train it. Evidence: (1) go/extmodel/attention_seq2seq.go is forward/generate only -- zero backward/grad/loss symbols; (2) the seeded recipe map in go/cmd/repodb/seed_model_profiles.go has only {inference, attention-seq2seq} (Load: ResolveModelSpec + LoadStackedAttentionSeq2Seq; Execute: AttentionSeq2SeqGenerate); training declarations exist only for dense_causal, alternating-window, pocket-tts, uvit scopes; (3) the research-tagged needle tests contain zero train/backward/grad references; (4) the model is JAX-vendor-trained: config.json jax_config (library jax, checkpoint needle.pkl) and the vendored repo ships its own launch_train.sh. Overgo matches the reference capability surface exactly; no training lane nobody has.

steps.title: matched protocol head-to-head, at-or-below
steps.verdict: AT-OR-BELOW, matched host protocol (both implementations host-side Go, same artifact, same oracle src/tgt). Overgo (internal/seq2seq TestDecodeWall, model loaded once, median-of-5): load 0.108-0.218s; encode+decode-full median 0.0203-0.0204s; generate-8 (encode + 8-token incremental greedy) median 0.0303-0.0308s. Reference (adaptive go test -tags research ./extmodel -run TestNeedleIncrementalDecodeMatchesJAXOracle -count=1 -v): test elapsed 0.42/0.43/0.44s across three runs -- that wall includes artifact resolve+load, dispatch calibration, encode, 8 incremental advances, oracle JSON read, and parity asserts (no per-op timer is reported). Honest composite: overgo load+generate-8 = 0.14-0.25s vs reference 0.42-0.44s test wall (~0.3-0.6x); op-only walls (20-31ms) are an order below the reference test wall even before subtracting its load. Verdict: at-or-below.
